page: UpCloud PREMIUM-1xCPU-2GB is an entry-level virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features a single shared vCPU mapped to an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 2.0 GB of RAM and 25 GB of local SSD storage. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supporting advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX512_VNNI and AVX512_BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark data reveals a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Due to its single-core configuration, multi-core stress-ng and PassMark CPU scores fall into the bottom 25% tier. However, single-core performance is highly competitive, with stress-ng single-core CPU metrics, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression all ranking in the top 10% tier. Memory performance is mixed; while large block write bandwidth is average, read bandwidth and overall PassMark memory scores are weak to poor.

This server represents a highly resource-dense, entry-level tier within UpCloud's Premium family. The shared CPU allocation provides access to modern AMD EPYC architecture at a low resource footprint, making it a cost-efficient option for lightweight workloads. It is best suited for single-threaded tasks, basic web serving, development environments, and lightweight background workers that do not require sustained multi-core processing or high memory bandwidth.
